message.guildmark.trade.report.filed: Your slip is taken and the board's row is chalked again from it. The town thinks the better of you.
message.guildmark.trade.report.off: The Word is off: there is no board to report to.
message.guildmark.trade.report.nowhere: A report is handed in at a town's board: stand in a capital.
message.guildmark.trade.report.here: You stand in that town: the board knows it as it is.
message.guildmark.trade.report.unknown: Your Tally has no sight of that town.
message.guildmark.trade.report.no_row: This board keeps no row for that town: it is too far off, or has no news yet.
message.guildmark.trade.report.stale: Your news of that town is not fresher than the board's by six hours: nobody would learn from it.
message.guildmark.trade.report.tired: You have filed three reports today. Come back tomorrow.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.booked: Booked: the tickets of that route are yours.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.gone: Word was old: that one's gone. Nothing was taken.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.refused: The town will not take that booking now. Nothing was taken.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.not_yet: Haul tickets are not open yet: there is nothing to book.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.glut: %2$s: a glut in %1$s, so I heard %3$s.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.glut.vag: %1$s: a glut somewhere, so I heard %2$s.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.hauled: %2$s to %3$s, brought in by %1$s; so I heard %4$s.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.hauled.v: %1$s, brought in from afar; so I heard %2$s.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.board.sh: %2$s: short in %1$s; the board's word is %3$s %4$s old.
%2$s: short in the town to the %1$s; the board's word is %3$s %4$s old.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.board.gl: %2$s: a glut in %1$s; the board's word is %3$s %4$s old.
%2$s: a glut in the town to the %1$s; the board's word is %3$s %4$s old.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.board.fa: %1$s: nothing short and nothing to spare; the board's word is %2$s %3$s old.
The town to the %1$s: nothing short and nothing to spare; the board's word is %2$s %3$s old.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.trade.board.no: Nothing is chalked on the Haul Board yet.
gui.guildmark.tally.ask.head: To be a %s:
gui.guildmark.tally.ask.none: The hall's book lists nothing for this rung yet.
gui.guildmark.tally.tab.held.urgent: A ticket is nearly out of time.
gui.guildmark.tally.tab.ledger.urgent: A parcel is on its last day.
gui.guildmark.tally.tab.standing.new: A rung climbed: the knot is not yet tied on the page.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.empty.title: No town in the book yet
gui.guildmark.tally.word.empty.body: Stand a minute in a capital, open its shop, or read a Haul Board: the town is written in.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.off: The Word is off: this book keeps only what you have seen yourself.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.scale.title: The scale
gui.guildmark.tally.word.scale.tip: North is at the top of the chart. An hour of walking is about %s blocks.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.legend.tip: The ring round a town is inked thick, dark and whole while its news is fresh; it thins, pales and breaks as the hours run, and is struck through at three days.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.road.title: Road at %s
gui.guildmark.tally.word.road.none: No road is kept for this town.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.road.tip: The worst road into the town, as the sight has it: green is open, amber troubled, red perilous, black closed.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.walk: A walk of %1$s from here (%2$s blocks)
gui.guildmark.tally.word.news.live: Live: kept by a stall of yours
gui.guildmark.tally.word.none.body: The Tally has no town to show you yet. Once a town is written in, pick it on the chart and its sight is set out here.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.glass.tip: Three days of sand. It has run as far as the news is old; what is left would last %s before the town is struck through.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.cell.stock: %1$s in stock, of the %2$s it keeps
gui.guildmark.tally.word.band.0: Scarce: under half of what it keeps
gui.guildmark.tally.word.cell.ticket: Haul tickets want %1$s of it, for %2$s
gui.guildmark.tally.word.notes.none: No trouble or luck noted there.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.note.over: Over by now, as far as the sight can tell
gui.guildmark.tally.word.tickets.old: As the town last had them; Book checks each against the town itself.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.title: File a report
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.tip: Hands what you saw of this town to the board here: its row is chalked again and the town thinks the better of you (%1$s points of standing, %2$s Trade XP). %3$s left today.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.off: The Word is off: no board to report to.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.nowhere: Stand in a capital to file a report.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.here: You stand here: its board knows it.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.norow: That board keeps no row for this town.
gui.guildmark.tally.word.report.same: Not newer than the board has it.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.live.tip: You stand in this town, so the baskets are priced on its shelves as they are this moment.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.old.tip: You are not in this town, so the baskets are priced on the book's last sight of it. Stand in it, and they are priced live.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.slots.title: Room to carry
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.slots.tip: The free slots in your pack and your carriers' packs. A basket is filled no further than this.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.way.best: The best an hour of walking pays from here.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.way.trip: %1$s blocks away: %2$s in all, with %3$s at the stalls
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.none.title: No way pays
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.none.body: No other town of your book pays for the walk from here. Stand a while in another capital, or read its Haul Board, and the book has more to weigh.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.nowhere.title: No town to start from
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.nowhere.body: The book has no town yet. Stand in a capital and the Word writes it in; the ways begin from there.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.locked.body: The hall opens the ways to a Hawker. The Standing page shows what that asks.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.locked.tip: The Routes open at the Hawker's rung.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.locked.title: Ways for Hawkers
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.locked.what: Ranks the towns of your book by what an hour of walking pays, and names the goods to carry there.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.pick.body: Pick a town from the list, and its basket is set out here: what to buy, what it fetches there, and the road between.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.road.title: The road
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.road.tip: About %1$s on foot over %2$s blocks, then %3$s at the stalls.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.sums.title: The basket in all
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.sums.tip: What the whole basket costs here, what it brings there, and what is left, in all and for each hour of the way: the walk there and the time at the stalls.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.slots.use: The basket takes %1$s of your %2$s free slots.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.book.title: Book the tickets
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.book.tip: Books the haul tickets this basket fills at %s: they are yours, and the town expects the goods.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.book.off: Haul tickets are not open yet.
gui.guildmark.tally.routes.book.none: This basket fills no haul ticket.
